greeting.text: Not now. Not now. Hold the gate.

before.text: They came for the crystal, and we are still here, and that is all anyone will remember. Thank you. Stand by the hall; I do not believe it is over.

after.text: She took it. A woman I have known since she was a girl, and she took it as if I were furniture. Go after her, Aldric. Go after both of them. I cannot give you an army. I can give you a ship, which is more than anyone gave me this morning.

choices.text: I will take the Gull, and thank you.

ship.text: She is at the quay, east of the courtyard. Mysidia's coast is a week by road and two days by the Gull; their elder will know where the crystals are going. Sail with the wind and tell no sailor where you are bound.

later.text: I will be here, with a broken city and a very long list of things I should have done.

ship_lent.text: Go, Aldric. The Gull is at the quay.
